mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (student_no, course_id, score) VALUES (#{studentNo}, #{courseId}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(s.id) AS count, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 1) AS average, MAX(s.score) AS highest, MIN(s.score) AS lowest, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS pass_rate FROM course c LEFT JOIN score s ON s.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
